Defeat your second opponent in your quest to learn polymock.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Defeat [[Plurgg]] in a game of [[Polymock]] at [[Vlox's Falls]].
* See [[Hoff]] [Polymock Master] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 100 [[Asura rank|Asura reputation points]]
* [[Kappa Polymock piece]]

==Walkthrough==
Plurgg's pieces and their unique skills are as follows:
#[[Fire Imp Polymock piece|Fire Imp]]: {{skill icon|Polymock Flare}}, {{skill icon|Polymock Immolate}}, {{skill icon|Polymock Meteor}}
#[[Ice Imp Polymock piece|Ice Imp]]: {{skill icon|Polymock Ice Spear}}, {{skill icon|Polymock Icy Prison}}, {{skill icon|Polymock Mind Freeze}}
#[[Kappa Polymock piece|Kappa]]: {{skill icon|Polymock Ice Spear}}, {{skill icon|Polymock Ice Shard Storm}}, {{skill icon|Polymock Frozen Trident}}

The following pieces are good counters:
*[[Skale Polymock piece]] vs. [[Fire Imp Polymock piece]]
*[[Fire Imp Polymock piece]] vs. [[Ice Imp Polymock piece]]
*[[Gargoyle Polymock piece]] vs. [[Kappa Polymock piece]]

Polymock Immolate and Polymock Ice Shard Storm deal considerable damage, however they are slow casting, making them easy to block or interrupt. As long as you interrupt them and prevent your own damage skills from being interrupted with [[Polymock Block]], [[Polymock Glyph of Concentration]] and timing, you should have no problem. If you hit them first with a high damage dealing throw then block, then do a concentration block then a long term affliction, you should win.
